verdict.rationale: telli is a voice-agent platform, so letting its agents use MCP servers as tool sources is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows agents connecting to MCP servers. Agents get tools only through custom API integrations, built-in system tools such as web_search, and transfer tools. The documented telli MCP server works the other way round: it lets external AI tools talk to Charlie, so it does not count as MCP-client support for voice agents.
